description: Multiple boundaries intensify together and overwhelm ordinary adaptation capacity.
Protection becomes unequal while vulnerable communities absorb rising ecological risk.
Unequal adaptation and abandonment erode trust social stability and democratic legitimacy.
Future technology assumptions delay mitigation restoration and governance reform.
Efficiency gains are offset by total growth mineral demand land pressure and rebound effects.
International agreements improve but weak enforcement finance and trust limit implementation.
Regional systems strengthen locally but fail to coordinate across larger planetary pressures.

risk_name: Implementation Gap in Safe and Just Transition
description: Strong pathway design fails if finance law institutions and legitimacy are weak.
